# Figure Eight: hand-drawn GSAP page transition for websites

Figure Eight draw, swell and reveal transition. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents.

![Figure Eight: hand-drawn GSAP page transition for websites](demo/preview.jpg)

[Open the demo](demo/index.html) · [Demo prompt](demo/PROMPT.md) · [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) · [References](REFERENCES.md)

## What it does

Build the Figure Eight hand-drawn GSAP page transition. Two loose loops cross and open across the frame. Use when the user asks for Figure Eight, the figure-eight transition, or this named draw-swell-cover-reveal effect on a website. Ships reusable curves, adaptive portrait fronts, a covered routing lifecycle and a working demo.

## Use it

- **Claude Code**: copy this folder to `~/.claude/skills/gsap-transition-figure-eight/` (or run `python3 install.py` from the repository root), then ask in your own words or call `/gsap-transition-figure-eight`.
- **Codex**: copy this folder into your Codex skills directory and ask: "Use $gsap-transition-figure-eight to add the Figure Eight page transition to this site."
- **Other agents**: point the agent at [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) and let it follow the steps.
